name: Saturn's Subtitle Tweaks
description: Saturn's Subtitle Tweaks (SST) adds Find subtitles to the Jellyfin Web playback menu: search remote subtitles, download through Jellyfin providers, and apply a temporary timing offset for the current playback only.
overview: In-player subtitle search, download, and session-only timing for Jellyfin Web.

versions.changelog: Keep the CC subtitle sheet on screen. Find subtitles stays at the top; extra tracks scroll instead of running under the taskbar.
